data.body: Lane f041: patch set 2 (e226f95db7a2) got LLM-Review -1, with 1 blocking api-compat finding: `README.md:215` still advertised the removed `rebar workflow edit` command. Docs gates and 470 docs tests pass. Still owned by dendriform-amethyst-hoopoe: deleting `docs/workflow-editor.md`, ADR 0071, the changelog/release notes, and the other docs pages (`docs/architecture.md`, `docs/README.md`, `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`). Its README/workflow-engine cites will need re-anchoring.
